admission.justification: Weighed documented initialize-only ServerMiddleware against private SDK monkeypatching and deferred removal until mcp exposes a stable hook, constraining future mcp upgrades and server dispatch wiring.

alternatives.option: Use documented ServerMiddleware from mcp.server.context strictly on the initialize method in preserve_handshake_extensions while keeping call_tool dispatch on public MCPServer.call_tool subclassing.
alternatives.reason: Preserves pre-2026 SEP-2640 capability fields without touching any private SDK attribute or placing provisional middleware on the tool-call path.

alternatives.option: Monkeypatch mcp.server.lowlevel or ServerCapabilities internals to emit pre-2026 extension fields without middleware.
alternatives.reason: Couples the server to private SDK internals that DEP-R04@v2 forbids and that break across mcp 2.x releases.
alternatives.reconsider_when: Never under the public-API boundary; only a documented public SDK hook may replace middleware.

alternatives.option: Remove ServerMiddleware entirely and configure initialize capability extension serialization through a stable non-middleware mcp SDK option.
alternatives.reason: mcp 2.3.0 provides no stable non-middleware hook for preserving pre-2026 initialize capabilities.extensions and capabilities.experimental.
alternatives.reconsider_when: When the pinned mcp SDK version adds a stable non-middleware hook for pre-2026 ServerCapabilities extension serialization or stabilizes ServerMiddleware.

consequences: ServerMiddleware from mcp.server.context is the sole provisional SDK API retained in the repository, confined to initialize in skills_extension.py, while all tool registration, listing, compaction, dispatch, and tests stay strictly on stable public SDK APIs.
context: Upgrading to mcp 2.3.0 strips pre-2026 ServerCapabilities.extensions and ServerCapabilities.experimental during initialize schema validation unless preserved through a server hook; DEP-R04@v2 retired all private SDK attributes and required any retained provisional SDK API to be explicitly bounded and recorded.
decider: Developer rulings D998/D1003 and DEP-R04@v2 Rule 2
